description: Buildfarm results for one PostgreSQL commit: every animal that built it, with branch, status (passed/failed/flapping), the failing stage and the log url, plus a {passed, failed, flapping, unknown} rollup. commit_sha is a SHA (>= 7 hex) or a branch, tag or major version (17, 9.6) for the commit it points at. Cite the commit SHA and the log urls.

commit_sha.description: A commit SHA (>= 7 hex), or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io), or a branch, tag or major version (17, 9.6) for the commit it points at

name: commit_buildfarm_status
